memories.title: Hostel drama: the extended cut.
memories.text: You used to talk to me for hours about your hostel and friend circle drama. Hours, Pashu. At that point it wasn’t an update, it was an audiobook. With a very large supporting cast.
memories.alt: Nandini and her friend sitting together
memories.caption: Me, getting the full version.

memories.title: We meet. A new season drops.
memories.text: Every time we meet, there’s another season of lore. New developments, returning characters, and me trying to remember who we were annoyed with last time. No recap skipped. Obviously I’m invested.
memories.alt: Nandini and her friend smiling for a photo
memories.caption: Another meeting. Another season.

crush: You had an Assamese crush. Your imagination heard that and immediately ordered a full romance arc. Pashu, it was a crush, not a green light for season two. ♡
